# The Jargonaut

> The Jargonaut explains corporate law through pop culture. It publishes blog articles on corporate law, fintech regulation and market dynamics, plus HANKETSU, a manga-style retelling of landmark court judgments.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://thejargonaut.in.net/): Introduction, Hanketsu episodes and featured blog posts
- [Hanketsu](https://thejargonaut.in.net/hanketsu): Landmark judgments told as manga episodes
- [About](https://thejargonaut.in.net/about): About The Jargonaut and its team
- [Contact](https://thejargonaut.in.net/contact): How to get in touch

## Optional

- Blog posts are available at `https://thejargonaut.in.net/post/{slug}`
